title: Target Renegade
build: Supplied OneLoad64 EasyFlash edition; cartridge SHA-256 4a15d0ee31f58427723170975a31bd05a900e9a5914bd84f8fc28c742e4ed924

tools.analysis: Python 3.9; Node.js 25.8.1; kit cartridge/snapshot readers, native VICE state tests, 6502 simulator and pixel comparison
tools.browser: Codex in-app browser; desktop and 390-pixel iframe checks

accuracy.note: C64-Wiki and the Commodore section of the Spanish Total compilation manual, read before final annotations.

Bronze: 22 entry/table comments. Author review checked five of 16 handwritten comments (title fire, keyboard test, new-game lives, interrupt setup, score digits). The simulator checked 256 score-byte cases and four keyboard/joystick cases. All six generated title rows were checked against their 27-byte copy boundaries; three rows were read individually. This is not an independent sample or audit.
Partitioned native resource loads, decoded graphics, music, sound effects, stage transitions and the initial combat routines.

Foundation sample: 40 of 60 handwritten comments and 20 of 856 generated comments. Four handwritten details and fifteen generated sprite-writer citations were wrong. All occurrences of those claims were corrected. One unsupported table-mutation claim was removed; four unverifiable references to a future browser were removed. No full audit. Weighted error estimate before corrections: 70.7%, dominated by the repeated sprite citation.
Completed the shared engine, pointer-dispatched code, combat/AI/pose tables and raster/mirror routines. All four RAM ledgers have zero bare bytes.
Native map, score, sound and reflection comparisons. Following the effect-driver active/sequence flags also corrected the page player's end condition.

Draw from 379 handwritten and 1,243 generated comments: 40 handwritten and 20 generated selected. The first checker completed 40 before its usage limit; a fresh independent checker completed the remaining 20. Five handwritten sound-driver detail errors were corrected, including every matching sequence-table sentence. No full audit. Unweighted rate 8.3%; stratum-weighted estimate 2.9%. Recommend a full audit.

All four parts. The 458 handwritten comments were each read and checked against the code; the 1,164 generated comments, in 33 template families, were checked by a script for every instance and read by hand for at least eight each. Every claim in facts.md and features.md was checked (88 claims: two corrected, 15 not checkable without the live emulator or snapshots), and so was the page copy. 56 comments corrected.
Drawn after the audit from all four parts; 22 of the 60 were sprite-shape template comments.
